name: E to E Transportation Infrastructure Ltd
tagline: Rs ~650 Cr NSE-SME railway signalling / telecom / electrification turnkey EPC -- FY25 revenue Rs 254 Cr (+47%) but swung to a Rs ~7.5 Cr loss in H1-FY26 with 220 debtor days; asset-light turnkey model with lumpy execution and heavy working capital
business_overview: E to E Transportation Infrastructure (NSE SME: E2ERAIL) does design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of signalling, telecom, electrification and turnkey railway projects for Indian Railways, PSUs and private clients across mainline, urban transit and private sidings, on an asset-light turnkey model with in-house engineering and selective outsourcing of execution. It is also pitching a proprietary 'Railway Intelligence Platform'.
fundamentals_table: Rs 253.8 Cr FY25 (+47% from Rs 172.5 Cr FY24)
Rs 14.0 Cr FY25 -> LOSS of Rs 7.5 Cr H1-FY26
NSE SME, listed ~Jan 2026 at a ~90% premium
fundamentals_narrative: FY25 showed strong top-line growth, but the first reported half as a listed company swung to a loss (Rs -7.5 Cr H1-FY26 vs Rs +14 Cr for full FY25), and debtor days near 220 confirm a working-capital-heavy, lumpy turnkey EPC profile with mediocre through-cycle return ratios (ROE ~13%). Railway signalling / electrification EPC is competitive and tender-driven; the asset-light framing does not remove execution and receivable risk. The 'Railway Intelligence Platform' is an unproven adjacency, not a current earnings driver.
